targets.title: ✦INTRADAY TRADER✦ 10 trades a day or 1 perfect one? Which trader are you? 👇
targets.author: Intraday trader
targets.text:
Intraday trading for beginners: why overtrading kills accounts, and how waiting for one clean setup beats taking 10 random trades every day.
Many beginners think more trades mean more profit. In reality, overtrading brings more fees, more emotional decisions and more mistakes. Professional intraday traders often take just 1-3 high-quality trades and wait patiently for the rest. This video is for every trader who wants to trade less, think more and let discipline do the work.
